2014_spells.cloud-of-daggers.description: You fill the air with spinning daggers in a cube 5 feet on each side, centered on a point you choose within range. A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.
2014_spells.cloud-of-daggers.effectSumma: Deal 4d4 slashing damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.cloud-of-daggers.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, you fill the air with spinning daggers in a cube 5 feet on each side, centered on a point you choose within range. A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 2nd. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 minute.
